scored.answer: At about 3:17, the forklift arrives in front of the Aisle 1 and Aisle 2 racks, after entering from the right at about 3:10.
A white truck with a trailer backs toward Dock 1 from about 9:47.5 to 9:57.5 (around 9:47–9:57 in the video).
Boxes fall off the upper shelf of Aisle 3 between about 15:22.5 and 15:27.5, tumbling or sliding to the right toward the EXIT door.
The worker in the yellow hi-vis vest walks across the floor around 21:10 to 21:22.5, moving from the left beside the aisle 1 racking to the right near the aisle 3 racking and exit door.

No caption clearly describes a spill. The closest is a small blue object that appears on the grey floor in front of Aisle 1 and Aisle 2 at about 26:52.5 and grows larger by 26:57.5, but it is not described as liquid.
The exit is blocked from about 32:17.5 until about 32:45, when a stack of red crates on a wooden pallet sits in front of the EXIT door on the right. The stack is gone by 32:47.5.
A worker climbs a silver ladder in Aisle 1 between about 38:35 and 38:40 in the video.

Around 44:05 to 44:22: a blue and an orange forklift converge toward the center in front of the racks, with a raised fork frame between them, before both leave the view. The captions don't explicitly describe a collision, so this is the closest match.
A fire breaks out on the middle rack in Aisle 2 starting around 50:17.5, burning with flames and smoke through about 50:40, and it is gone by 50:47.5.
The lights go out around 55:40 to 55:47, stay dark through about 55:57, and begin to brighten by 56:05.
